description: When source files fail to parse or imports are unresolvable, return a partial graph plus a `Warnings[]` list of `{file, kind, message}` entries. Hard fail only on catastrophic project errors (missing `tsconfig.json`, unreadable path, broken parser process). Mid-migration scenarios are first-class inputs.

requirements.description: When individual source files fail to parse or import references cannot be resolved, the Extract operation must return a partial graph covering all successfully parsed content plus a Warnings[] list. Each warning entry must be a structured object with fields: file (absolute path), kind (enum: PARSE_ERROR, UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT, etc.), and message (human-readable description). Hard failures (panic-level) are reserved exclusively for catastrophic conditions: missing tsconfig.json, unreadable project path, or a sidecar process that has exhausted its restart budget. Mid-migration projects with broken imports or syntax errors are first-class supported inputs.
requirements.title: Partial Graph Extraction with Structured Warnings

validation.notes: Test that a project with one unparseable file returns a partial graph excluding that file plus a PARSE_ERROR warning
Test that an unresolvable import produces an UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT warning with the correct file and import path
Test Warning struct serialization includes file, kind, and message fields with correct types
Test that multiple warnings are aggregated and all returned in a single response
Test that a missing tsconfig.json triggers a hard error, not a warning
TCG-PARTIAL-GRAPH: Extract on a fixture project with one intentionally broken import returns a graph with all other nodes plus one warning entry
Extract on a fixture with a syntax error in one file returns partial graph and PARSE_ERROR warning; remaining files are fully represented
Verify that the Warnings[] field is included in the Connect-RPC response proto envelope
A team running typescript-code-graph against a mid-migration monorepo receives usable graph data rather than a total failure
Warnings are surfaced in the UI Graph Explorer alongside the partial graph results

title: Partial Graph + Structured Warnings
